title: Landauer limit
references: Landauer, R., Irreversibility and Heat Generation in the Computing Process, IBM Journal of Research and Development 5(3), 183-191 (1961), doi:10.1147/rd.53.0183
validity_domain: Heat dissipated into a thermal environment at absolute temperature T by the logically irreversible erasure of one bit of information.
limitations: Applies to the erasure of a bit (a logically irreversible operation), not to the energy a whole computer draws
Logically reversible computation has no such lower bound
A lower bound on the heat per erased bit: real hardware dissipates many orders of magnitude more, and the bound says nothing about the energy per operation of a circuit

variables.T: Absolute temperature of the environment receiving the heat
